r14_dwarf_01_tusks_at_the_timberline.description:
Boars are tearing through the timberline stores outside Hearthpine. Drive off three by day, and bring any ordinary meat you keep to Hilda Hearthspoon at the separate oven.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_dwarf_01_tusks_at_the_timberline.title: Tusks at the Timberline

r14_dwarf_02_meat_for_the_smokehouse.description:
The shared oven feeds everyone returning from hearthpine's outer paths. Bring four raw meat portions to Hilda Hearthspoon beside the oven. Take this provision job before the short local hunt; carried or traded meat counts, and Cooking is not required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_dwarf_02_meat_for_the_smokehouse.title: Meat for the Smokehouse

r14_dwarf_03_rats_in_the_woodpiles.description:
The woodpile pests exposed rotten braces beneath the winter stacks. Bring six pine planks for the store frames; ordinary boards from local pine trunks, carried or traded, are equally useful.

Requirements: Minimum level: 3; Complete: Tusks at the Timberline.
r14_dwarf_03_rats_in_the_woodpiles.title: Boards for the Winter Stacks

r14_dwarf_04_lanterns_after_sundown.description:
After nightfall, zombies approach the lantern line outside Hearthpine. Defeat three on that night patrol. They begin in the level-3 country; do the daytime store work or optional tool lessons if the sun is still up.

Requirements: Minimum level: 4; Complete: Tusks at the Timberline.
r14_dwarf_04_lanterns_after_sundown.title: Lanterns After Sundown

r14_dwarf_05_the_high_path.description:
Ibex knock loose slate above Hearthpine's high path by day. Clear the animals on level-4-and-up ground along the ledges.

Requirements: Minimum level: 5; Complete: Boards for the Winter Stacks.
r14_dwarf_05_the_high_path.title: The High Path

r14_dwarf_06_loose_stone_on_copper_road.description:
At level 10, take the road to Copperfell Village and speak with Orrik Pineledger. Copperfell Foothills is level 11–20 country: this is a conversation handoff, not a demand to clear the whole road. Complete it with Orrik at the village.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The High Path.
r14_dwarf_06_loose_stone_on_copper_road.title: The Road to Orrik Pineledger

r14_dwarf_07_a_ledger_in_the_scrub.description:
Foxes scattered an ore ledger in the scrub. Clear the den so Orrik can recover the pages.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Orrik Pineledger.
r14_dwarf_07_a_ledger_in_the_scrub.title: A Ledger in the Scrub

r14_dwarf_08_hold_the_marker_stones.description:
Goblins use Copperfell's marker stones to signal across the pass at night. Break their signal party so Mara can guide the next ore wagon. Look for this threat after nightfall in the named regional zone.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: A Ledger in the Scrub.
r14_dwarf_08_hold_the_marker_stones.title: Hold the Marker Stones

r14_dwarf_09_ash_under_the_nails.description:
The bandits stole ore tallies and marked them with a hooked sun. Defeat the camp; Tovin waits inside with what he learned. Speak with the captive for compatible supply tasks before clearing the camp; the captive also accepts this combat report.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Hold the Marker Stones.
r14_dwarf_09_ash_under_the_nails.title: Ash Under the Nails

r14_dwarf_10_an_axe_worth_carrying.description:
Bring a wood axe so Brunna can show where its edge belongs and where it does not.

Open Basics in your Crafting tab to see the wood axe recipe: three planks and two sticks. You can make planks from a tree trunk and sticks from planks. Wood tools are fragile; stone lasts longer and bronze is your first durable upgrade. This lesson is optional; an axe made by a friend is welcome too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_dwarf_10_an_axe_worth_carrying.title: An Axe Worth Carrying

r14_dwarf_11_stone_before_steel.description:
Bring a stone pick. The lesson is optional, but the mountain is less forgiving than wood.

Use Basics to make a wooden pick first, then mine stone. The stone pick recipe uses three stone blocks across the top and two sticks down the middle. Keep valuable tools repaired through a profession trainer in a settlement. This lesson is optional; a traded pick counts too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 2; Complete: An Axe Worth Carrying.
r14_dwarf_11_stone_before_steel.title: Stone Before Steel

r14_elf_01_roots_laid_bare.description:
Boars expose young roots outside Silverleaf by day. Drive off three, then consider taking spare raw meat to Liora Dewpot at the grove's separate oven.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_elf_01_roots_laid_bare.title: Roots Laid Bare

r14_elf_02_the_grove_s_portion.description:
The shared oven feeds everyone returning from silverleaf's outer paths. Bring four raw meat portions to Liora Dewpot beside the oven. Take this provision job before the short local hunt; carried or traded meat counts, and Cooking is not required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_elf_02_the_grove_s_portion.title: The Grove's Portion

r14_elf_03_beneath_the_seed_baskets.description:
The seed baskets need a sound frame before the youngest roots can be covered again. Bring six ordinary oak planks; nearby oak trunks provide them, and traded boards are welcome. Silverwood is not required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 3; Complete: Roots Laid Bare.
r14_elf_03_beneath_the_seed_baskets.title: A Frame for the Seed Baskets

r14_elf_04_footfalls_without_breath.description:
Zombies cross the moss ring outside Silverleaf after nightfall. Defeat three in the level-3-and-up glades. Store repairs and optional tool lessons need not wait for darkness.

Requirements: Minimum level: 4; Complete: Roots Laid Bare.
r14_elf_04_footfalls_without_breath.title: Footfalls Without Breath

r14_elf_05_keepers_of_the_saplings.description:
Foxes worry the sapling guards by day on level-4-and-up ground outside Silverleaf. Clear the animals from the tended ring.

Requirements: Minimum level: 5; Complete: A Frame for the Seed Baskets.
r14_elf_05_keepers_of_the_saplings.title: Keepers of the Saplings

r14_elf_06_axes_without_leave.description:
At level 10, follow the road to Starbough Village and speak with Ilyra Mossveil. Starbough Vale is level 11–20 country, so prepare before leaving the safer glades. Complete the conversation with Ilyra; no fighting or return trip is part of this handoff.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: Keepers of the Saplings.
r14_elf_06_axes_without_leave.title: The Road to Ilyra Mossveil

r14_elf_07_quiet_the_lower_boughs.description:
Poachers cut beside Starbough's lower boughs after nightfall. Defeat six in Starbough Vale so Ilyra can put the wardens back on their working paths.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Ilyra Mossveil.
r14_elf_07_quiet_the_lower_boughs.title: Quiet the Lower Boughs

r14_elf_08_watch_the_green_road.description:
Foxes scatter the scouts' trail signs. Clear the green road before Theren patrols it.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Quiet the Lower Boughs.
r14_elf_08_watch_the_green_road.title: Watch the Green Road

r14_elf_09_cinders_in_green_cloth.description:
The bandits carry green cloth burned by a hooked-sun mark. Defeat them and speak with Nima inside the camp. Speak with the captive for compatible supply tasks before clearing the camp; the captive also accepts this combat report.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Watch the Green Road.
r14_elf_09_cinders_in_green_cloth.title: Cinders in Green Cloth

r14_elf_10_the_careful_axe.description:
Bring a wood axe. Saelin's lesson is about choosing a tree before raising the tool.

Open Basics in your Crafting tab to see the wood axe recipe: three planks and two sticks. You can make planks from a tree trunk and sticks from planks. Wood tools are fragile; stone lasts longer and bronze is your first durable upgrade. This lesson is optional; an axe made by a friend is welcome too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_elf_10_the_careful_axe.title: The Careful Axe

r14_elf_11_stone_s_patient_lesson.description:
Bring a stone pick and learn why stone rewards patience rather than force.

Use Basics to make a wooden pick first, then mine stone. The stone pick recipe uses three stone blocks across the top and two sticks down the middle. Keep valuable tools repaired through a profession trainer in a settlement. This lesson is optional; a traded pick counts too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 2; Complete: The Careful Axe.
r14_elf_11_stone_s_patient_lesson.title: Stone's Patient Lesson

r14_human_01_boars_beyond_the_fence.description:
Boars root through the outer seed rows by day. Drive off three beyond Dawnmere's fence, and take spare raw meat to Bess Honeycrust beside the village oven.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_human_01_boars_beyond_the_fence.title: Boars Beyond the Fence

r14_human_02_the_smokehouse_share.description:
The shared oven feeds everyone returning from dawnmere's outer paths. Bring four raw meat portions to Bess Honeycrust beside the oven. Take this provision job before the short local hunt; carried or traded meat counts, and Cooking is not required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_human_02_the_smokehouse_share.title: The Smokehouse Share

r14_human_03_granary_teeth.description:
The granary's damaged braces leave the baskets open to pests. Bring six oak planks to repair the store frame. Boards already in your pack or obtained by trade count too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 3; Complete: Boars Beyond the Fence.
r14_human_03_granary_teeth.title: Braces for the Granary

r14_human_04_shapes_by_lanternlight.description:
Zombies approach Dawnmere's lantern road after nightfall. Defeat three beyond the houses in the level-3-and-up fields. The daytime repair work and optional tool lessons remain alternatives while the road is quiet.

Requirements: Minimum level: 4; Complete: Boars Beyond the Fence.
r14_human_04_shapes_by_lanternlight.title: Shapes by Lanternlight

r14_human_05_the_missing_flock.description:
Wild turkeys draw off Dawnmere's village flock by day. Thin them near the outer fields while the store frame is repaired.

Requirements: Minimum level: 5; Complete: Braces for the Granary.
r14_human_05_the_missing_flock.title: The Missing Flock

r14_human_06_flock_on_mill_road.description:
At level 10, travel to Goldmead Village and speak with Marta Millward. Goldmead Vale is level 11–20 country; follow the road instead of trying to clear every creature. Complete this handoff with Marta there.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Missing Flock.
r14_human_06_flock_on_mill_road.title: The Road to Marta Millward

r14_human_07_orchard_watch.description:
Foxes have moved into the orchard margins. Give Marta's pickers room to work.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Marta Millward.
r14_human_07_orchard_watch.title: Orchard Watch

r14_human_08_empty_snares.description:
The poachers left empty snares around the outpost. Jon wants the hunters found before they return. Look for this threat after nightfall in the named regional zone.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Orchard Watch.
r14_human_08_empty_snares.title: Empty Snares

r14_human_09_the_blackened_tally.description:
The bandits burned a hooked-sun mark into stolen grain tallies. Clear the camp and hear Pella's account. Speak with the captive for compatible supply tasks before clearing the camp; the captive also accepts this combat report.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Empty Snares.
r14_human_09_the_blackened_tally.title: The Blackened Tally

r14_human_10_a_woodsman_s_edge.description:
Bring a wood axe and Elian will explain safe trees, shared timber and the first repair.

Open Basics in your Crafting tab to see the wood axe recipe: three planks and two sticks. You can make planks from a tree trunk and sticks from planks. Wood tools are fragile; stone lasts longer and bronze is your first durable upgrade. This lesson is optional; an axe made by a friend is welcome too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_human_10_a_woodsman_s_edge.title: A Woodsman's Edge

r14_human_11_a_pick_for_the_road.description:
Bring a stone pick for a short lesson before the road leaves the soft fields.

Use Basics to make a wooden pick first, then mine stone. The stone pick recipe uses three stone blocks across the top and two sticks down the middle. Keep valuable tools repaired through a profession trainer in a settlement. This lesson is optional; a traded pick counts too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 2; Complete: A Woodsman's Edge.
r14_human_11_a_pick_for_the_road.title: A Pick for the Road

r14_orc_01_tusks_at_the_water_skins.description:
Boars tear the water skins outside Sunscar by day. Drive off three and carry spare raw meat to Ugra Brothstone at the separate oven.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_orc_01_tusks_at_the_water_skins.title: Tusks at the Water Skins

r14_orc_02_meat_for_the_long_fire.description:
The shared oven feeds everyone returning from sunscar's outer paths. Bring four raw meat portions to Ugra Brothstone beside the oven. Take this provision job before the short local hunt; carried or traded meat counts, and Cooking is not required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_orc_02_meat_for_the_long_fire.title: Meat for the Long Fire

r14_orc_03_rats_under_the_hide_racks.description:
The hide racks need new feet before another load pulls them into the dust. Bring six acacia planks from the ordinary local timber, or use boards already carried or traded.

Requirements: Minimum level: 3; Complete: Tusks at the Water Skins.
r14_orc_03_rats_under_the_hide_racks.title: Posts Beneath the Hide Racks

r14_orc_04_the_thirsting_dead.description:
Sun-dried husks walk the outer flats toward Redtusk after nightfall. Defeat three on the level-4-and-up ground between the camp and the Redtusk border before they reach the water skins. The rack repairs and optional tool lessons remain daytime work.

Requirements: Minimum level: 5; Complete: Tusks at the Water Skins.
r14_orc_04_the_thirsting_dead.title: The Thirsting Dead

r14_orc_05_shells_by_the_bedrolls.description:
Scorpions have crawled under the bedrolls. Clear the camp edge before nightfall. Near the start they hunt by day and by night on level-4-and-up ground.

Requirements: Minimum level: 5; Complete: Posts Beneath the Hide Racks.
r14_orc_05_shells_by_the_bedrolls.title: Shells by the Bedrolls

r14_orc_06_husks_on_redtusk_road.description:
At level 10, follow Redtusk Road to Redtusk Village and speak with Borak Redgrass. Redtusk Savanna is level 11–20 country, not a beginner hunting ground. Complete the conversation with Borak; this handoff requires neither a kill nor a return trip.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: Shells by the Bedrolls.
r14_orc_06_husks_on_redtusk_road.title: The Road to Borak Redgrass

r14_orc_07_teeth_around_the_herd.description:
Hyenas circle the village herd. Thin the pack before it learns the fences.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Borak Redgrass.
r14_orc_07_teeth_around_the_herd.title: Teeth Around the Herd

r14_orc_08_scour_the_dry_wash.description:
Scorpions fill the dry wash below the outpost. Clear Kesh's patrol route. Look for this threat after nightfall in the named regional zone.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Teeth Around the Herd.
r14_orc_08_scour_the_dry_wash.title: Scour the Dry Wash

r14_orc_09_no_forge_made_this_brand.description:
The bandits branded supplies with a hooked sun no orcish forge made. Defeat them and hear Rokka's account. Speak with the captive for compatible supply tasks before clearing the camp; the captive also accepts this combat report.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Scour the Dry Wash.
r14_orc_09_no_forge_made_this_brand.title: No Forge Made This Brand

r14_orc_10_edge_of_the_first_camp.description:
Bring a wood axe. Gara will show the safe cut before strength becomes waste.

Open Basics in your Crafting tab to see the wood axe recipe: three planks and two sticks. You can make planks from a tree trunk and sticks from planks. Wood tools are fragile; stone lasts longer and bronze is your first durable upgrade. This lesson is optional; an axe made by a friend is welcome too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_orc_10_edge_of_the_first_camp.title: Edge of the First Camp

r14_orc_11_stone_has_no_pride.description:
Bring a stone pick. Stone has no pride, but it punishes a careless swing.

Use Basics to make a wooden pick first, then mine stone. The stone pick recipe uses three stone blocks across the top and two sticks down the middle. Keep valuable tools repaired through a profession trainer in a settlement. This lesson is optional; a traded pick counts too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 2; Complete: Edge of the First Camp.
r14_orc_11_stone_has_no_pride.title: Stone Has No Pride

r14_troll_01_boars_in_the_yam_beds.description:
Jungle boars turn up the yam beds outside Kapok by day. Drive off three, and bring spare raw meat to Zemi Sweetroot at the separate oven shelter.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_troll_01_boars_in_the_yam_beds.title: Boars in the Yam Beds

r14_troll_02_fill_the_evening_pot.description:
The shared oven feeds everyone returning from kapok's outer paths. Bring four raw meat portions to Zemi Sweetroot beside the oven. Take this provision job before the short local hunt; carried or traded meat counts, and Cooking is not required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_troll_02_fill_the_evening_pot.title: Fill the Evening Pot

r14_troll_03_teeth_in_the_basket_weave.description:
Kapok's dry baskets need a new frame above the wet ground. Bring six junglewood planks for the supports. Ordinary planks from local jungle trunks, existing supplies and traded boards all count.

Requirements: Minimum level: 3; Complete: Boars in the Yam Beds.
r14_troll_03_teeth_in_the_basket_weave.title: A Dry Frame for the Baskets

r14_troll_04_dead_in_the_rootways.description:
Zombies wander the rootways beyond Kapok after nightfall. Defeat three on level-3-and-up ground. The basket repair and optional tool lessons are available without waiting for the night patrol.

Requirements: Minimum level: 4; Complete: Boars in the Yam Beds.
r14_troll_04_dead_in_the_rootways.title: Dead in the Rootways

r14_troll_05_vipers_under_broad_leaves.description:
Vipers shelter beneath the broad leaves beside the homes. Clear the nearest nests. Near the start they hunt by day and by night on level-4-and-up ground.

Requirements: Minimum level: 5; Complete: A Dry Frame for the Baskets.
r14_troll_05_vipers_under_broad_leaves.title: Vipers Under Broad Leaves

r14_troll_06_claws_on_raincall_road.description:
At level 10, follow the route to Raincall Village and speak with Daro Kapok. Raincall Basin is level 11–20 country; prepare your equipment and avoid wandering into its hunters. Complete this handoff with Daro, with no fighting errand or return trip.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: Vipers Under Broad Leaves.
r14_troll_06_claws_on_raincall_road.title: The Road to Daro Kapok

r14_troll_07_the_coiled_footpath.description:
Vipers emerge along the village footpath after nightfall. Clear Raincall's nearby rainforest ground so Daro can reopen the walk.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Daro Kapok.
r14_troll_07_the_coiled_footpath.title: The Coiled Footpath

r14_troll_08_cats_at_the_reed_line.description:
Jungle lynx watch the reed line below the outpost. Clear Neshi's patrol route.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: The Coiled Footpath.
r14_troll_08_cats_at_the_reed_line.title: Cats at the Reed Line

r14_troll_09_smoke_beneath_the_rain.description:
The bandits' wet cargo smoulders without being consumed and bears a hooked sun. Defeat them and speak with Veko. Speak with the captive for compatible supply tasks before clearing the camp; the captive also accepts this combat report.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Cats at the Reed Line.
r14_troll_09_smoke_beneath_the_rain.title: Smoke Beneath the Rain

r14_troll_10_a_dry_handled_axe.description:
Bring a wood axe and Zalima will show how to keep the handle dry and the cut clean.

Open Basics in your Crafting tab to see the wood axe recipe: three planks and two sticks. You can make planks from a tree trunk and sticks from planks. Wood tools are fragile; stone lasts longer and bronze is your first durable upgrade. This lesson is optional; an axe made by a friend is welcome too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_troll_10_a_dry_handled_axe.title: A Dry-Handled Axe

r14_troll_11_stone_beneath_the_moss.description:
Bring a stone pick for a lesson in reading rock beneath moss and root.

Use Basics to make a wooden pick first, then mine stone. The stone pick recipe uses three stone blocks across the top and two sticks down the middle. Keep valuable tools repaired through a profession trainer in a settlement. This lesson is optional; a traded pick counts too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 2; Complete: A Dry-Handled Axe.
r14_troll_11_stone_beneath_the_moss.title: Stone Beneath the Moss

r14_undead_01_boars_in_the_dead_furrows.description:
Plague boars churn Stillgrave's outer furrows by day. Drive off three before the retaining stones loosen, and take spare raw meat to Neral Saltkeeper by the oven.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_undead_01_boars_in_the_dead_furrows.title: Boars in the Dead Furrows

r14_undead_02_salt_for_what_remains.description:
The shared oven feeds everyone returning from stillgrave's outer paths. Bring four raw meat portions to Neral Saltkeeper beside the oven. Take this provision job before the short local hunt; carried or traded meat counts, and Cooking is not required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_undead_02_salt_for_what_remains.title: Salt for What Remains

r14_undead_03_gnawing_in_the_crypt_store.description:
The crypt stores need dry shelves above the damp soil. Bring six gravewood planks, the ordinary boards cut from this region's gravewood trunks. Existing or traded boards count; nothing must be taken from a protected tomb.

Requirements: Minimum level: 3; Complete: Boars in the Dead Furrows.
r14_undead_03_gnawing_in_the_crypt_store.title: Dry Shelves for the Crypt Stores

r14_undead_04_the_uncalled_dead.description:
Three uncalled zombies have wandered into Stillgrave's outer furrows. The patrol sets out after nightfall, although blight-ground zombies can linger through daylight too. Seek level-3-and-up ground; the store repairs do not depend on this patrol.

Requirements: Minimum level: 4; Complete: Boars in the Dead Furrows.
r14_undead_04_the_uncalled_dead.title: The Uncalled Dead

r14_undead_05_furrows_gone_sour.description:
Bring eight cobble blocks to shore up Stillgrave's outer retaining stones. The boar patrol has already done its part; this repair is ordinary material delivery, not another hunt.

Requirements: Minimum level: 5; Complete: Dry Shelves for the Crypt Stores.
r14_undead_05_furrows_gone_sour.title: Stones Against the Sour Furrows

r14_undead_06_tusks_along_the_fen_road.description:
At level 10, take the fen road to Mournfen Village and speak with Mordec Silt. Mournfen is level 11–20 country; keep clear of its hungry banks while travelling. Complete this conversation with Mordec there, without an added hunt or return journey.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: Stones Against the Sour Furrows.
r14_undead_06_tusks_along_the_fen_road.title: The Road to Mordec Silt

r14_undead_07_mud_that_moves.description:
Bog ooze is choking the village sluice. Break it apart before the water backs into the paths.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Mordec Silt.
r14_undead_07_mud_that_moves.title: Mud That Moves

r14_undead_08_clear_the_sluice.description:
Crocodiles have claimed the outpost channel. Clear the bank for Sera's patrol.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Mud That Moves.
r14_undead_08_clear_the_sluice.title: Clear the Sluice

r14_undead_09_fire_that_the_fen_cannot_d.description:
The bandits carried cloth hot without flame, marked by a hooked sun. Defeat them and let Hollis explain what the fen could not cool. Speak with the captive for compatible supply tasks before clearing the camp; the captive also accepts this combat report.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Clear the Sluice.
r14_undead_09_fire_that_the_fen_cannot_d.title: Fire That the Fen Cannot Drown

r14_undead_10_a_handle_that_will_not_rot.description:
Bring a wood axe so Veyra can show how living handles are kept sound in dead soil.

Open Basics in your Crafting tab to see the wood axe recipe: three planks and two sticks. You can make planks from a tree trunk and sticks from planks. Wood tools are fragile; stone lasts longer and bronze is your first durable upgrade. This lesson is optional; an axe made by a friend is welcome too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r14_undead_10_a_handle_that_will_not_rot.title: A Handle That Will Not Rot

r14_undead_11_a_pick_among_headstones.description:
Bring a stone pick for a lesson in separating useful rock from a sealed grave.

Use Basics to make a wooden pick first, then mine stone. The stone pick recipe uses three stone blocks across the top and two sticks down the middle. Keep valuable tools repaired through a profession trainer in a settlement. This lesson is optional; a traded pick counts too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 2; Complete: A Handle That Will Not Rot.
r14_undead_11_a_pick_among_headstones.title: A Pick Among Headstones

r15_dwarf_local_01.description:
The workshop needs ordinary cobble to reset its cartway after the last rockfall. Bring sound blocks from the local slopes.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Orrik Pineledger.
r15_dwarf_local_01.title: Stone for the Workyard

r15_dwarf_local_02.description:
Foxes leave fangs among the scattered tool baskets. Bring two ordinary fox fangs from the Copperfell hunt so Dagna can show the workers which animals caused the damage.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Orrik Pineledger.
r15_dwarf_local_02.title: Fangs in the Tool Baskets

r15_dwarf_local_03.description:
The goblins on Copperfell's night signal path carry linen scraps. Bring two while helping Mara hold the marker stones; Mara can bind the recovered signal poles with the scraps.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: A Ledger in the Scrub.
r15_dwarf_local_03.title: Scraps from the Signal Path

r15_dwarf_local_04.description:
Ibex crowd the shelf beside the guard shelter and send stones through its stores. Thin the herd around the post.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: A Ledger in the Scrub.
r15_dwarf_local_04.title: Sure Feet, Loose Stones

r15_dwarf_local_05.description:
Tovin recognises the ore carriers' tally knots on the stolen purses. Recover two from the camp so he can identify whose winter wages went missing. Accept this request before the camp fight; ordinary carried or traded purses also count.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Hold the Marker Stones.
r15_dwarf_local_05.title: The Ore Carriers' Purses

r15_dwarf_local_06.description:
The raiders wrapped the stolen tools in their own linen. Bring some of that ordinary camp cloth so Tovin can identify the bundles.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Hold the Marker Stones.
r15_dwarf_local_06.title: Cloth Around the Stolen Tools

r15_elf_local_01.description:
Rain has loosened the lashings above the communal walk. Bring ordinary leather so the bindings can be replaced.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Ilyra Mossveil.
r15_elf_local_01.title: Leather for the Covered Walk

r15_elf_local_02.description:
Bring three ordinary linen cloth pieces from the local night poachers so Lethri can bind the damaged guards while Ilyra clears the lower boughs.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Ilyra Mossveil.
r15_elf_local_02.title: Linen at the Sapling Cuts

r15_elf_local_03.description:
After nightfall, poachers cross the lookout's open ground when the patrol turns. Clear the approach and restore the long view.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Quiet the Lower Boughs.
r15_elf_local_03.title: No Shadow on the Sightline

r15_elf_local_04.description:
Bring two ordinary fox fangs from the Starbough road hunt. Theren uses them to explain the warning signs while the trail markers are reset; no second fox count is needed.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Quiet the Lower Boughs.
r15_elf_local_04.title: Fangs Beside the Trail Signs

r15_elf_local_05.description:
The stolen purses carry travel knots from the bough road. Recover two for the captive; their owners can then be traced through the wardens' records. Accept this request before the camp fight; ordinary carried or traded purses also count.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Watch the Green Road.
r15_elf_local_05.title: Knots from the Bough Road

r15_elf_local_06.description:
The cut trunks are bound with the raiders' linen cloth. Bring enough camp cloth for Nima to compare its knots with the poachers' work.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Watch the Green Road.
r15_elf_local_06.title: Bindings from the Worksite

r15_human_local_01.description:
The granary crew cannot leave the open shed while carts are queued. Bring raw meat for their common pot.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Marta Millward.
r15_human_local_01.title: Food for the Granary Crew

r15_human_local_02.description:
The orchard crew needs provisions while Marta's watch clears the foxes. Bring four ordinary apples, gathered from nearby apple trees or supplied from your pack.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Marta Millward.
r15_human_local_02.title: Apples for the Orchard Crew

r15_human_local_03.description:
The night poachers around Goldmead carry ordinary linen cloth. Bring three pieces while helping Jon investigate the empty snares, rather than setting out on a second identical hunt.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Orchard Watch.
r15_human_local_03.title: Cloth from the Empty Snares

r15_human_local_04.description:
Foxes keep tripping the warning cords across the lookout's open sightline. Clear the slope so the next alarm means danger.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Orchard Watch.
r15_human_local_04.title: A Clear Eastern View

r15_human_local_05.description:
Pella saw the millers' purses thrown beside the scorched grain tallies. Recover two stolen purses from the camp before the bandits divide the harvest pay. Accept this request before the camp fight; ordinary carried or traded purses also count.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Empty Snares.
r15_human_local_05.title: The Millers' Missing Pay

r15_human_local_06.description:
The raiders tied the gathered grain with their own linen cloth. Bring enough camp cloth for Pella to mark the recovered sacks.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Empty Snares.
r15_human_local_06.title: Linen Around the Grain

r15_orc_local_01.description:
The broad house's low annex needs fresh ties for its hide screens. Bring ordinary leather from the local hunt.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Borak Redgrass.
r15_orc_local_01.title: Hide for the Low Annex

r15_orc_local_02.description:
Bring two ordinary fangs from the hyenas circling Redtusk's herd. Morga will hang them beside the repaired hide screens while Borak's herd patrol is under way.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Borak Redgrass.
r15_orc_local_02.title: Fangs Beyond the Annex

r15_orc_local_03.description:
Hyenas wait below the timber lookout and scatter anyone carrying stores uphill. Clear the post's approach.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Teeth Around the Herd.
r15_orc_local_03.title: Howls Below the Lookout

r15_orc_local_04.description:
The scorpions in Redtusk's dry wash emerge after sunset. Bring two ordinary venom sacs from that same outing so Kesh can show the guards what to avoid along the angled palisade.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Teeth Around the Herd.
r15_orc_local_04.title: Venom Beside the Palisade

r15_orc_local_05.description:
The bandits kept the carriers' pay in stolen purses instead of adding it to the food stores. Recover two for the captive so the raided herd crews can reclaim their share. Accept this request before the camp fight; ordinary carried or traded purses also count.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Scour the Dry Wash.
r15_orc_local_05.title: The Carriers' Cut

r15_orc_local_06.description:
The stolen freight is tied with the raiders' linen cloth. Bring enough of it for Rokka to compare the knots and brands.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Scour the Dry Wash.
r15_orc_local_06.title: Bindings from the Loaded Sled

r15_troll_local_01.description:
The village preparation shelter has room for another shared meal. Bring raw meat from the basin hunt.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Daro Kapok.
r15_troll_local_01.title: Meat for the Preparation Roof

r15_troll_local_02.description:
Tapirs push through the shade beneath the communal house. Thin the herd before the low path is blocked.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Daro Kapok.
r15_troll_local_02.title: Hooves Between the Stilt Posts

r15_troll_local_03.description:
Vipers have claimed the dry equipment niche beside the roofed lookout. Clear them after nightfall.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: The Coiled Footpath.
r15_troll_local_03.title: A Dry Niche for Supplies

r15_troll_local_04.description:
Bring two ordinary leather pieces for Neshi's patrol packs while clearing the daytime jungle lynx from Raincall's reed line. Carried or traded leather is welcome; there is no second counted cat hunt.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: The Coiled Footpath.
r15_troll_local_04.title: Leather for the Reed-Line Packs

r15_troll_local_05.description:
Ferry workers tie coloured cords around their pay purses. Recover two stolen purses from the camp and let the captive match those cords to the missing crews. Accept this request before the camp fight; ordinary carried or traded purses also count.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Cats at the Reed Line.
r15_troll_local_05.title: Pay from the Ferry Road

r15_troll_local_06.description:
The camp's sleeping shelters keep the raiders' linen cloth dry. Bring enough for Veko to wrap the smouldering cargo safely.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Cats at the Reed Line.
r15_troll_local_06.title: Dry Bindings in the Rain

r15_undead_local_01.description:
The wax keeper uses local slime gel to seal jars against the fen damp. Bring enough for the raised store shelves.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Mordec Silt.
r15_undead_local_01.title: Gel for the Wax Store

r15_undead_local_02.description:
Plague boars root against the stones of the tended memorial. Drive them back into the dead furrows.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Mordec Silt.
r15_undead_local_02.title: Furrows by the Memorial

r15_undead_local_03.description:
Bring two ordinary crocodile teeth from Mournfen's muddy banks while helping Sera clear the sluice. They will mark the safest side of the watch channel without another counted crocodile hunt.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Mud That Moves.
r15_undead_local_03.title: Teeth from the Watch Channel

r15_undead_local_04.description:
Bog ooze pools beneath the observation niche and eats at its supports. Break up the nearest masses.

Requirements: Minimum level: 11; Complete: Mud That Moves.
r15_undead_local_04.title: The Sheltered Niche

r15_undead_local_05.description:
Two stolen purses may still carry the names scratched into their bone tags. Bring them to the captive so the missing carriers can be entered in the camp account. Accept this request before the camp fight; ordinary carried or traded purses also count.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Clear the Sluice.
r15_undead_local_05.title: Names on the Purse Tags

r15_undead_local_06.description:
The inner-band raiders carry linen that stayed dry inside the ruined enclosure. Bring enough for Hollis to wrap the heat-marked scrap.

Requirements: Minimum level: 12; Complete: Clear the Sluice.
r15_undead_local_06.title: Dry Cloth from a Wet Ruin

r20_anchor_014_01.description:
The cairn beside Tarnwatch's bent southern lane has shed its mortar into the caravan track. Bring ten sound cobble blocks for its base; the smith can fit them while the sleds are unloaded. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_014_01.title: The Cairn Mortar

r20_anchor_014_02.description:
Ibex come down the conifer slopes by day and knock the loaded sleds against Tarnwatch's hall. Clear four animals from Frostbarrow Shelf while the masons reset the cairn.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_014_02.title: Hooves Above the Sleds

r20_anchor_014_03.description:
With the sled lane open, Edda can hear raiders signalling beyond the cairn after dark. Defeat four goblin raiders in Frostbarrow Shelf before their night party learns where the caravans sleep.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Hooves Above the Sleds.
r20_anchor_014_03.title: The Bell After Dark

r20_anchor_016_01.description:
Whitebridge's little market press has lost the brace that keeps its frame square. Bring eight ordinary oak planks for the covered workbench; the nearby boatworkers have already claimed the sound timber in their own stock. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_016_01.title: The Press Frame

r20_anchor_016_02.description:
Poachers set snares along Whitebridge Shire's grass and forest margins at night, then bring their catch past the market close. Remove four of them so the morning wagons can use that approach.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_016_02.title: The Poacher's Market

r20_anchor_016_03.description:
Now the snares are quiet, the watch can distinguish the lights that belong to no traveller. Hunt three wisps after dark among Whitebridge Shire's damp ground and woodland litter; the bridge itself is not their spawning ground.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Poacher's Market.
r20_anchor_016_03.title: A Light Beyond the Bridge

r20_anchor_018_01.description:
Berrycourt's orchard crew needs a low stone rim to keep washed soil against the roots. Bring eight cobble blocks to Lorindor Berrycourt, leaving the tended trees and protected court intact. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_018_01.title: Stones Around the Roots

r20_anchor_018_02.description:
At night, poachers work Lorindor's silver-leaf and forest margins beyond Berrycourt. Defeat four of them while the orchard crew rebuilds the root beds.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_018_02.title: No Snares in Berrycourt

r20_anchor_018_03.description:
The snares have gone, but pale lights still lead late pickers away from Lorindor's orchard paths. Disperse three wisps after dark around the damp woodland, then report back to Ilwen.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: No Snares in Berrycourt.
r20_anchor_018_03.title: The Uninvited Lanterns

r20_anchor_020_01.description:
The namekeeper will not let another stone tablet rest on a rotten archive shelf. Bring eight gravewood planks to Ossuary Ledgerstead; the local gravewood trunks make the boards these shelves require. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_020_01.title: Shelves for the Remembered

r20_anchor_020_02.description:
Blightfang wolves hunt along Ossuary Reach's bone-forest floor and cut off visitors carrying names to the archive. Defeat four of them without disturbing the memorial plots.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_020_02.title: Teeth Beside the Archive

r20_anchor_020_03.description:
Once the wolf tracks are cleared, the night watch can reach the older grove. Three gravewood treants there keep tearing at the boundary markers after dark. Put them down in Ossuary Reach and bring the report to Sovel.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Teeth Beside the Archive.
r20_anchor_020_03.title: The Trees That Refuse Rest

r20_anchor_022_01.description:
Wellhold's water jars stand in the sun whenever a shade brace splits. Bring eight acacia planks for the roof above the jars; do not dismantle the village's shelters for timber. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_022_01.title: Shade Before Strength

r20_anchor_022_02.description:
Speargrass tigers cross the dry grass by day and stalk the cutters approaching Wellhold. Clear three from Speargrass Reach while the shade is repaired.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_022_02.title: Stripes in the Cutting Grass

r20_anchor_022_03.description:
The cutters can reach the well again, but the jars are unsafe after sunset. Hunt four scorpions on Speargrass Reach's dry grass and clay when they emerge at night.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Stripes in the Cutting Grass.
r20_anchor_022_03.title: Night at the Water Jars

r20_anchor_024_01.description:
Whisperreed's landing needs crosspieces strong enough to keep laden travellers above the mud. Bring eight junglewood planks to the sheltered landing workshop; this is a repair delivery, not a boatbuilding lesson. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_024_01.title: A Landing That Holds

r20_anchor_024_02.description:
Tapirs crowd the dry paths through Whispering Reedlands by day. Clear four so carriers can bring their loads to Whisperreed Landing without stepping into the pools.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_024_02.title: Tapirs on the Dry Path

r20_anchor_024_03.description:
The cleared paths are drawing travellers after dusk, when false lights gather over the reeds. Disperse three wisps in Whispering Reedlands at night and return to Taleko.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Tapirs on the Dry Path.
r20_anchor_024_03.title: Cold Lights in the Reeds

r20_anchor_026_01.description:
Rimebell keeps its signal fuel under a roof because wet coal serves no watch. Bring six coal lumps for that dry store while the lookout checks the shelf road. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_026_01.title: Fuel Under Cover

r20_anchor_026_02.description:
Snow leopards hunt Frostbarrow Shelf's gravel and snowy patches at night. Defeat three near the sled routes before another caravan loses its rear guard.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_026_02.title: The Sled Track Pack

r20_anchor_026_03.description:
After the cats are driven back, the watch can read the new notches on its signal pole. They match a goblin slinger band's night signals. Defeat four slingers in Frostbarrow Shelf.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Sled Track Pack.
r20_anchor_026_03.title: Notches on the Signal Pole

r20_anchor_027_01.description:
The wind has pulled Splitbolt's shutters off their braces. Bring eight pine planks for the storm-facing shelter; the snowy pines of Stormvault Heights provide suitable timber. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_027_01.title: Shutters Against the Storm

r20_anchor_027_02.description:
Frost strays stand on Stormvault Heights' gravel and snow after dark, loosing arrows across the ascent. Defeat four so the watch can reach its storm markers.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_027_02.title: The Frost That Walks

r20_anchor_027_03.description:
With the ascent watched again, Borin can point you toward Slatehook Camp in Stormvault Heights. Defeat four bandit archers around that occupied camp; they are camp guards, not the roaming night poachers.

Requirements: Minimum level: 33; Complete: The Frost That Walks.
r20_anchor_027_03.title: Slatehook's Cargo

r20_anchor_028_01.description:
Archshadow's sighting stones no longer line up across the ridge crossing. Bring eight cobble blocks for their low footing so the watch can reset the line without narrowing the passage. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_028_01.title: Stones for the Sighting Line

r20_anchor_028_02.description:
Crag eagles dive over Stormvault Heights' rocky ground by day. Defeat three that threaten travellers using the crossing, then report to Archshadow Post.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_028_02.title: Wings Over the Crossing

r20_anchor_028_03.description:
The ridge report names the Throng watch in Blackwind Rise across the frontier. At level 40, defeat three Throng guards at its military outposts or their patrols. These are armed garrisons, not villagers or players; do not approach Nhal Veyr's stronger city watch.

Requirements: Minimum level: 40; Complete: Wings Over the Crossing.
r20_anchor_028_03.title: The Watch Beyond the Ash Wind

r20_anchor_030_01.description:
The cart beside Oakspan Tollhouse cannot move until its axle supports are replaced. Bring eight oak planks for the covered cart bay while the road patrol clears the approach. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_030_01.title: An Axle for the Empty Cart

r20_anchor_030_02.description:
Poachers hide their snares in Whitebridge Shire's grass and forest margins at night. Defeat four so the tollhouse crew can recover the road markers in daylight.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_030_02.title: The Tollhouse Snares

r20_anchor_030_03.description:
After the snare line is removed, strange lights still cross the darker wet ground near Oakspan. Disperse three wisps in Whitebridge Shire after nightfall.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Tollhouse Snares.
r20_anchor_030_03.title: Night Lights at Oakspan

r20_anchor_031_01.description:
Embers blow straight through the low gap in Cinderline's wind wall. Bring ten cobble blocks for that gap so the watch's covered barrels stay sheltered. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_031_01.title: A Wall Against Embers

r20_anchor_031_02.description:
Ashen treants move through Ashenward March's forest litter at night. Defeat three before the watch sends another barrel crew into those scorched stands.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_031_02.title: The Ashen Wood Stirs

r20_anchor_031_03.description:
The barrel route is usable again, and its stolen cargo has been traced to Coalbrand Camp in Ashenward March. Defeat four bandit archers guarding that camp's supplies.

Requirements: Minimum level: 33; Complete: The Ashen Wood Stirs.
r20_anchor_031_03.title: Coalbrand's Watchers

r20_anchor_032_01.description:
The last hedge has gaps wide enough for loaded wagons to drift off the dispatch lane. Bring eight oak planks for the marker posts at Last Hedge Redoubt. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_032_01.title: Posts for the Last Hedge

r20_anchor_032_02.description:
Skeleton raiders take the dispatch road through Ashenward March after nightfall. Defeat four while the watch restores the road's markers.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_032_02.title: Dead on the Dispatch Road

r20_anchor_032_03.description:
The dispatches identify a Throng garrison across Bannerbreak Mesa. At level 40, defeat three Throng guards at those frontier military posts or their patrols. Leave civilians, players and Gor Drazhak's city watch outside this mission.

Requirements: Minimum level: 40; Complete: Dead on the Dispatch Road.
r20_anchor_032_03.title: Standards Across the Mesa

r20_anchor_034_01.description:
Petalbank's trough has lost the stone kerb that keeps washwater out of the berry baskets. Bring eight cobble blocks for its edge; the covered court must stay open to carriers. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_034_01.title: The Trough's New Kerb

r20_anchor_034_02.description:
Poachers enter Lorindor's woodland at night and force Petalbank's wardens away from the gathering routes. Defeat four so the wardens can take their normal posts again.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_034_02.title: Wardens Without Arrows

r20_anchor_034_03.description:
The wardens have rehung their own lamps, but other lights still move beyond them after dark. Disperse three wisps in Lorindor's damp woodland and report to Petalbank.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Wardens Without Arrows.
r20_anchor_034_03.title: Lanterns We Did Not Hang

r20_anchor_035_01.description:
Moonfall's chart table rocks whenever the lookout marks a route. Bring eight oak planks for its frame; the observatory is a shelter for path-watchers, not a new magical instrument. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_035_01.title: A Chart Table Repaired

r20_anchor_035_02.description:
Wolves prowl Moonfall Wood's forest floor beneath the fallen boughs. Defeat four so the observers can check the lake paths without abandoning their charts.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_035_02.title: Fangs Beneath the Fallen Bough

r20_anchor_035_03.description:
The clear paths expose a second hazard: poachers return to the wood at night. Defeat four in Moonfall Wood before the next dawn survey follows their snare line.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Fangs Beneath the Fallen Bough.
r20_anchor_035_03.title: The Moonlit Snare Line

r20_anchor_036_01.description:
Rain has loosened the footing beneath Glassroot Gate's cliff passage. Bring ten cobble blocks for the low support so carriers can keep using the route while it is repaired. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_036_01.title: Stone Under the Passage

r20_anchor_036_02.description:
Rootsnare Camp's bandits have taken supplies intended for the passage. Defeat four bandits at the occupied camp in Glassroot Wilds, rather than hunting unrelated forest creatures.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_036_02.title: Rootsnare's Stolen Cloth

r20_anchor_036_03.description:
The recovered report points across Thunderroot Wilds to the Throng's frontier watch. At level 40, defeat three Throng guards at those military outposts or their patrols. This does not include villagers, players or Kezamba's capital guard.

Requirements: Minimum level: 40; Complete: Rootsnare's Stolen Cloth.
r20_anchor_036_03.title: The Other Rootwatch

r20_anchor_038_01.description:
Boneledger's stone names have outlasted their wooden shelf. Bring eight gravewood planks for the record shelter so the watch can keep road reports separate from memorial tablets. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_038_01.title: A Shelf for Stone Names

r20_anchor_038_02.description:
Gravewood treants stir on Ossuary Reach's bone-covered forest floor after dark. Defeat three before the next ledger carrier follows that road.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_038_02.title: The Hungry Gravewood

r20_anchor_038_03.description:
With the night grove quiet, the keeper can send carriers farther along the road. Defeat four blightfang wolves in Ossuary Reach so the hungry packs do not take their place.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Hungry Gravewood.
r20_anchor_038_03.title: A Pack on the Ledger Road

r20_anchor_039_01.description:
Ashveil reads its wind markers by lamplight, but the covered fuel box is nearly empty. Bring six coal lumps for the lamps before the next night watch. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_039_01.title: Keep the Lamps Burning

r20_anchor_039_02.description:
Gravewood treants move among Blackwind Rise's bone-littered trees after dark. Defeat three so the watchers can read the branches' movement without confusing it with the wind.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_039_02.title: Ash Among Living Branches

r20_anchor_039_03.description:
Vaska's cleared sightline reveals who is carrying the stolen cloth: Pallcloth Camp's archers. Defeat four bandit archers in that Blackwind Rise camp and return to the watch.

Requirements: Minimum level: 33; Complete: Ash Among Living Branches.
r20_anchor_039_03.title: The Pallcloth Thieves

r20_anchor_040_01.description:
Hollowarch's dispatch shelf has sagged under damp message stones. Bring eight local gravewood planks to the roofed station; the old arches themselves must remain untouched. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_040_01.title: The Dispatch Shelf

r20_anchor_040_02.description:
Plaguehide bears move through Blackwind Rise's bone-forest floor beside the arch approaches. Defeat three before the next carrier attempts the crossing.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_040_02.title: Claws Beneath the Arch

r20_anchor_040_03.description:
The dispatches name the Accord watch in Stormvault Heights. At level 40, defeat three Accord guards at the frontier outposts or their patrols there. Do not attack civilians, players or Dur Brannoc's city watch for this report.

Requirements: Minimum level: 40; Complete: Claws Beneath the Arch.
r20_anchor_040_03.title: The Watch Under the Storm

r20_anchor_042_01.description:
Cutgrass Watch has a roof cloth but too few sound posts to hold its shade. Bring eight acacia planks for the cutters' waiting place beside the shelter. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_042_01.title: Posts for the Shade

r20_anchor_042_02.description:
Speargrass tigers hunt the dry cutting grounds by day. Defeat three in Speargrass Reach so the cutters can bring their bundles back to the watch.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_042_02.title: The Cutters' Long Walk

r20_anchor_042_03.description:
The daytime route is clearer, but goblin raiders gather near the signal paths after sunset. Defeat four in Speargrass Reach during the night watch.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Cutters' Long Walk.
r20_anchor_042_03.title: Raiders at the Signal Fire

r20_anchor_043_01.description:
The mesa ramp's side supports need replacing before another heavy load climbs it. Bring ten acacia planks to Red Ramp Post's sheltered work area. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_043_01.title: Planks for the Ascent

r20_anchor_043_02.description:
Scorpions emerge on Bannerbreak Mesa's clay and dry grass after dark, hiding among stored planks. Defeat four while the ramp crew keeps its loads under cover.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_043_02.title: Shells Among the Planks

r20_anchor_043_03.description:
Once the plank yard is safe, Drek can send you toward Sunderstrap Camp. Defeat four bandit archers guarding its stolen loads in Bannerbreak Mesa.

Requirements: Minimum level: 33; Complete: Shells Among the Planks.
r20_anchor_043_03.title: Sunderstrap's Sentinels

r20_anchor_044_01.description:
Tornstandard's banner footing is splitting where the supply lane bends. Bring eight cobble blocks for the low base, leaving the working military banner in place. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_044_01.title: A Standard Needs a Footing

r20_anchor_044_02.description:
Skeleton raiders cross Bannerbreak Mesa's clay and dry ground at night. Defeat four so dispatch runners can reach the hold before dawn.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_044_02.title: The Empty Mesa Patrol

r20_anchor_044_03.description:
The next report concerns the Accord's Last Hedge frontier in Ashenward March. At level 40, defeat three Accord guards at the military outposts or their patrols in that zone. Civilians, players and Highcourt's city watch are not targets.

Requirements: Minimum level: 40; Complete: The Empty Mesa Patrol.
r20_anchor_044_03.title: The Last Hedge Abroad

r20_anchor_046_01.description:
Reedvoice's signal shelf has sunk below the driest line on its posts. Bring eight junglewood planks to raise the shelf inside the shelter without blocking the reed-path entrance. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_046_01.title: A Dry Signal Shelf

r20_anchor_046_02.description:
Jungle lynx watch Whispering Reedlands' forest margins by day and keep the signal carriers from their paths. Defeat four, then return to Reedvoice Station.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_046_02.title: Cats by the Reed Pipes

r20_anchor_046_03.description:
The carriers can travel by day, but lights in the wet reeds mimic the station's signals after dusk. Disperse three wisps in Whispering Reedlands at night.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Cats by the Reed Pipes.
r20_anchor_046_03.title: The False Answering Lights

r20_anchor_047_01.description:
Totemwater's rope rack needs sound crosspieces before the next river crossing. Bring eight junglewood planks for the covered rack; the river path must stay open beside it. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_047_01.title: Rope Rack Timbers

r20_anchor_047_02.description:
Crocodiles wait on Totemwater Reach's muddy banks where carriers leave the path. Defeat three and give the crossing crew room to work.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_047_02.title: Jaws at the River Path

r20_anchor_047_03.description:
With the banks clearer, the crew can see bog ooze collecting below the route marker. Break up four in Totemwater Reach's muddy ground before the next load comes through.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Jaws at the River Path.
r20_anchor_047_03.title: Mud Around the Marker

r20_anchor_048_01.description:
Thunderstep's roof runoff cuts across the forest ascent. Bring eight cobble blocks for a shallow gutter beside the shelter, keeping the walking line free. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_048_01.title: A Gutter Before the Rain

r20_anchor_048_02.description:
Rainchar Camp's bandits hold supplies intended for the ascent. Defeat four bandits at that occupied camp in Thunderroot Wilds and report to Rumela.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_anchor_048_02.title: Rainchar's Burning Cargo

r20_anchor_048_03.description:
The report points across Glassroot Wilds to the Accord's frontier watch. At level 40, defeat three Accord guards at its military outposts or their patrols. This mission concerns armed guards, never villagers, players or Lethariel's capital watch.

Requirements: Minimum level: 40; Complete: Rainchar's Burning Cargo.
r20_anchor_048_03.title: Across the Glass Passage

r20_anchor_061_01.description:
Tarncut's spare pick has lost its working head, and the sorting crew needs a replacement. Bring one ordinary stone pick, made or traded; no proof of mining is required. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_061_01.title: A Handle for the Cutting

r20_anchor_061_02.description:
Mountain rams wander Frostbarrow Shelf's rocky ground by day and block the mine's haul approaches. Clear four while the crew sorts the next load.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_061_02.title: Rams on the Haul Lane

r20_anchor_061_03.description:
The daytime lane is open, but snow leopards hunt the shelf's gravel and snow after dusk. Defeat three during the cold shift so the next sled can leave safely.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Rams on the Haul Lane.
r20_anchor_061_03.title: The Cold Shift

r20_anchor_062_01.description:
Bridgechalk's pale cutting face needs timber braces above the working edge. Bring ten oak planks to the quarry shelter; this shallow worksite is not a newly opened underground mine. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_062_01.title: Braces for the Pale Face

r20_anchor_062_02.description:
Poachers set snares in Whitebridge Shire's grassy and wooded margins at night, catching the quarry surveyors' route. Defeat four before the crew returns to its markers.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_062_02.title: The Surveyor's Snare

r20_anchor_062_03.description:
With the survey route clear, the quarry can put another hand on the stone. Bring an ordinary stone pick to the work shelter; a traded or previously used pick counts. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Surveyor's Snare.
r20_anchor_062_03.title: A Quarry Hand's Pick

r20_anchor_063_01.description:
Paleroot's cutters need a spare stone pick for work beside the orchard roots. Bring one to the braced shelter; you may craft it, buy it or use an existing spare. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_063_01.title: A Gentle Edge

r20_anchor_063_02.description:
Poachers cross Lorindor's woodland at night and disturb the survey stakes outside the cutting. Defeat four so the crew can recover its marked line in daylight.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_063_02.title: The Survey Stakes Vanish

r20_anchor_063_03.description:
The recovered line leads into damp ground where wisps gather after dark. Disperse three in Lorindor before another cutter mistakes them for work lamps.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Survey Stakes Vanish.
r20_anchor_063_03.title: Light on the Cutting Marks

r20_anchor_064_01.description:
Memoryvein keeps its rock tallies in a shed apart from the memorial stones. Bring eight gravewood planks for that shed's frame, using the local tree's ordinary sawn boards. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_064_01.title: The Record Shed Frame

r20_anchor_064_02.description:
Gravewood treants move through Ossuary Reach's bone forest after dark and keep the cutters from their return path. Defeat three without disturbing the tended memorials.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_064_02.title: The Cutters' Uneasy Night

r20_anchor_064_03.description:
The night route is quiet enough for a new cutting shift. Bring one ordinary stone pick for the crew's spare rack; no special relic or freshly mined stone is required. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Cutters' Uneasy Night.
r20_anchor_064_03.title: A Tool for Unnamed Stone

r20_anchor_065_01.description:
Redpick's sorting trays lie beneath a roof whose braces have begun to split. Bring ten acacia planks so the yard can keep its loads covered before the next caravan. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_065_01.title: Roof Over the Sorting Trays

r20_anchor_065_02.description:
Hyenas prowl Speargrass Reach's dry grass and clay near the cutters' water stops. Defeat four while the crew repairs the sorting roof.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_065_02.title: Hunters at the Water Shade

r20_anchor_065_03.description:
The water stops are safer, but scorpions emerge around the drill stacks after sunset. Defeat four in Speargrass Reach on the night shift.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: Hunters at the Water Shade.
r20_anchor_065_03.title: Stings in the Drill Stack

r20_anchor_066_01.description:
Reedstone's timber stacks must stay above the wet ground if the quarry is to remain workable. Bring eight junglewood planks for the raised supports beside its shelter. Existing or traded supplies are welcome.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_066_01.title: Timbers Kept Above Water

r20_anchor_066_02.description:
Bog ooze collects on Whispering Reedlands' muddy ground around the quarry approaches. Break up four so the crew can reach its stored tools.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_anchor_066_02.title: The Quarry Pool Moves

r20_anchor_066_03.description:
Once the ooze is cleared, the haulers can use the bank path again. Defeat three crocodiles on Whispering Reedlands' muddy banks before the next load leaves Reedstone Cut.

Requirements: Minimum level: 23; Complete: The Quarry Pool Moves.
r20_anchor_066_03.title: Jaws Along the Haul Path

r20_dwarf_capital_cook.description:
Varda Copperpan has places at the table for late arrivals in Dur Brannoc. Bring five raw meat portions to the bakehouse cook. The meal is a shared provision task, not a Cooking qualification test.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10.
r20_dwarf_capital_cook.title: Copperpan Supper

r20_dwarf_capital_intro.description:
Dur Brannoc's gates lead to trainers, repair services and the city's public workspaces. At level 10, follow the road to Dorrin Gateledger in the ancestor hall. Outside the city the country is more dangerous; keep to the route and avoid the higher-level wildlife. Speak with Dorrin and complete this introduction there.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10.
r20_dwarf_capital_intro.title: The Road to Dur Brannoc

r20_dwarf_capital_services.description:
Dorrin recommends the terrace bakehouse before your next climb. Speak with Varda Copperpan at the cook's place beside the oven, then complete the introduction with her. The Cooking trainer has a separate role; you do not need to learn the profession.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Dur Brannoc.
r20_dwarf_capital_services.title: A Seat at Copperpan

r20_dwarf_capital_stores.description:
The gate shift keeps its lamp fuel apart from the smiths' metal stock. Bring eight coal lumps to Dorrin so the night watch can replenish that reserve without taking the bakehouse's fuel.

Requirements: Minimum level: 20.
r20_dwarf_capital_stores.title: Lamp Coal for the Gate Shift

r20_dwarf_journey_01.description:
The capital keeps contact with the working settlements beyond its walls. Travel to Tarnwatch Fold in Frostbarrow Shelf and speak with Edda Tarnmantle. This is level 21–30 country; prepare your equipment before leaving the road. Complete the conversation with Edda Tarnmantle there. No parcel, fighting errand or return trip is required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 21.
r20_dwarf_journey_01.title: Word for Edda Tarnmantle

r20_dwarf_journey_02.description:
The settlement and its nearby cutters need a direct line for their next repair season. Travel to Tarncut Mine in Frostbarrow Shelf and speak with Kelda Screesort. This is level 21–30 country; prepare your equipment before leaving the road. Complete the conversation with Kelda Screesort there. No parcel, fighting errand or return trip is required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 24.
r20_dwarf_journey_02.title: Word for Kelda Screesort

r20_dwarf_journey_03.description:

This is level 31–40 country; prepare your equipment before leaving the road. Complete the conversation with Borin Splitbolt there. No parcel, fighting errand or return trip is required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_dwarf_journey_03.title: Word for Borin Splitbolt

r20_dwarf_start_cook.description:
Hilda keeps the timber shift fed beside Hearthpine's oven. Bring three coal lumps for its fuel box; existing or traded coal is welcome. If you mine it yourself, use a pickaxe, even wood or stone, on a natural coal source rather than dismantling protected village scenery.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r20_dwarf_start_cook.title: Warmth for the Timber Shift

r20_elf_capital_cook.description:
Mirael Petalpot keeps a common pot beside Lethariel's market bakehouse. Bring five raw meat portions for travellers and wardens sharing that table. You need no Cooking qualification to contribute.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10.
r20_elf_capital_cook.title: The Petalpot Share

r20_elf_capital_intro.description:

The woods beyond the protected city are level 20–30; avoid their wildlife while travelling. Speak with Eriath and complete the introduction in the hall.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10.
r20_elf_capital_intro.title: The Road to Lethariel

r20_elf_capital_services.description:
Eriath recommends Mirael Petalpot's table at the market bakehouse before you set out again. Speak with the cook beside the oven, then complete this introduction there. Learning Cooking from its separate trainer is optional.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Lethariel.
r20_elf_capital_services.title: Petalpot Hospitality

r20_elf_capital_stores.description:
The grove patrol needs ordinary oak boards for its covered stores. Bring ten planks to Eriath in Lethariel. Oak is welcome here; you do not need to cut a silverwood tree for this repair.

Requirements: Minimum level: 20.
r20_elf_capital_stores.title: Boards for the Grove Patrol

Requirements: Minimum level: 31.
r20_elf_journey_03.title: Word for Faeris Rootbinder

r20_elf_start_cook.description:
Liora Dewpot wants the grove's evening meal ready before the gatherers return. Bring three coal lumps to the oven in Silverleaf. Existing or traded fuel is welcome; a pickaxe is needed (wood and stone work too) if you choose to mine natural coal yourself.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r20_elf_start_cook.title: A Shared Grove Supper

r20_human_capital_cook.description:
Ansel Ovenward is setting a supper beside Highcourt's bakehouse for travellers who arrive after the bread is baked. Bring five raw meat portions for the pot. No Cooking profession is required.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10.
r20_human_capital_cook.title: Bread for the Late Arrivals

r20_human_capital_intro.description:

Requirements: Minimum level: 10.
r20_human_capital_intro.title: The Road to Highcourt

r20_human_capital_services.description:

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Highcourt.
r20_human_capital_services.title: The Ovenward Welcome

r20_human_capital_stores.description:
The river watch needs low stone blocks to reset its supply-yard edge. Bring twelve cobble blocks to Mariel at Highcourt. This asks for ordinary material, not proof that you mined it.

Requirements: Minimum level: 20.
r20_human_capital_stores.title: Stone for the River Watch

r20_human_journey_01.description:

r20_human_start_cook.description:
Bess Honeycrust has a second oven ready for Dawnmere's returning field hands. Bring three coal lumps for its fuel store. Traded supplies count; mining natural coal yourself only requires a pickaxe; wood and stone picks work too.

Requirements: Minimum level: 1.
r20_human_start_cook.title: The Second Oven

r20_orc_capital_cook.description:
Gorla Longladle has a ration pot beside Gor Drazhak's cook-court oven. Bring five raw meat portions for the next watch and its travellers. You can help without learning Cooking.

r20_orc_capital_cook.title: The Longladle Ration

r20_orc_capital_intro.description:
Gor Drazhak offers public workspaces, trainers and repairs beyond Sunscar's camp. At level 10, follow the road to Thorga Roadspeaker in the skull hall. Its surrounding country is level 20–30, so avoid the wildlife and keep to the route. Speak with Thorga and complete this introduction there.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10.
r20_orc_capital_intro.title: The Road to Gor Drazhak

r20_orc_capital_services.description:
Thorga recommends a stop at Gorla Longladle's cook court. Speak with the cook beside the oven in the warren, then complete the introduction there. The nearby Cooking trainer is not required for this conversation.

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Gor Drazhak.
r20_orc_capital_services.title: A Bowl at Longladle

r20_orc_capital_stores.description:
The muster yard's supply edge has been worn down by loaded carts. Bring twelve cobble blocks to Thorga so the watch can reset it without taking stone from occupied homes.

Requirements: Minimum level: 20.
r20_orc_capital_stores.title: Stone for the Muster Yard

Ugra Brothstone keeps Sunscar's long fire supplied beside the oven. Bring three coal lumps for the covered fuel box. Existing or traded coal is welcome; You can mine natural coal with any pickaxe, including wood or stone.

r20_orc_start_cook.title: Keep the Long Fire Fed

r20_troll_capital_stores.title: Boards for the Rain Stores

r20_undead_capital_intro.title: The Road to Nhal Veyr

r20_undead_capital_services.description:

Requirements: Minimum level: 10; Complete: The Road to Nhal Veyr.
r20_undead_capital_services.title: The Vigil Table

r20_undead_capital_stores.description:

Requirements: Minimum level: 20.
r20_undead_capital_stores.title: Coal for the Vigil Lamps

r20_undead_journey_01.description:
